title: Alberino's aid expedition to San Antonio de Pintoyaku
place_text: San Antonio de Pintoyaku, Peruvian Amazon

tellings.quote: Peru. This is the first time I was greeted by, you know, a small army of men with loaded shotguns.

plain: The filmmaker Tim Alberino says that in 2023 he led an aid trip to San Antonio de Pintoyaku, a village in the Peruvian Amazon, and was met there by "a small army of men with loaded shotguns", the first time that had ever happened to him. He tells Michels he was there himself, alongside companions he names as Doug Thornton, Ronnie Vernet and a man called Christian.
